text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black dives across! She surges 
past the post to cross the finish line in 
first place!
(――WOOOOAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Listen to this roaring cheer! This is... 
a festival! The Kitasan Festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... I'm...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Did I... win? Did I... really...—?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You're incredible, Kitasan Black--!! 
Yeahhh, number one in Japan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
That was magnificent, the absolute 
best!!!! Now go make the Winning Live one 
hell of a flashy show too!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I won!!!! Me!! Finally, finally, this 
view is mine—"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aha... Everyone's smiling... Just like 
that day for Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone, thank you so much!! I... I 
promise you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I'll get even stronger, 
stronger still!! And I'll deliver tons and 
tons of amazing races, just like today's!!
(WOOOOOOOOOAAAAHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Haha, look at that sparkling smile... 
Kitasan Black really is incredible after 
all.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Bright... positive... Even if she breaks, 
she gets right back up and starts 
running.)

On the way home from giving her all at the 
Kikuka Sho, Cheval Grand suddenly spoke 
up.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...T-T-T-Trainer-than!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Auugh. I'm sorry, right at the important 
part... Umm...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much for today. I'm so 
glad I got to run in the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I feel like this is the first time I've 
truly been able to look at Kita-san 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: And so, um... I, um...
choice_data_list: It's okay to take it slow.

text_block_list.text:
Struggling as she usually did to talk 
about herself, she did her best to find 
the words. It seemed she had something 
very important to say.

While strolling along leisurely, I listen 
to Cheval Grand's words.

—The story began back around the time of 
her debut.

About myself, who hadn't stood out 
compared to my classmates, and Kitasan 
Black, who had similarly gone unnoticed.

And yet, Kitasan Black was believing in 
herself and putting in positive effort. 
She secretly felt a sense of inferiority 
at the contrast between them.

After the Japan Derby, I learned that even 
she harboring feelings of inferiority 
toward someone.

And today... Kitasan Black turned even her 
feelings of inferiority into strength, 
directly receiving the cheers of the 
audience—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"When I was thinking, 'Everyone's so much 
better than me anyway...' I was actually 
blinded to what was right in front of me—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Kita-san's true strength...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
When you look up to someone, you chase 
after them earnestly. When you feel the 
gap between you, you get genuinely down 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I won't run away from feeling inferior to 
my peers. I'll train with all my might... 
and overcome my weak self—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
In the end, he's totally different from 
me... But... that's precisely why—

This must be where the real talk begins. 
Cheval Grand takes several deep breaths. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...! I... I'm about to—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm... going to say something very... 
p-presumptuous!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You can laugh at me if you want... Or 
think I'm hopeless... but please, just 
hear me out...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I couldn't help thinking it... I-I... I 
want to, t-too—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……I, ……wanna……!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I want to properly become stronger... too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Just like how Kita-san proved her own 
strength today...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Looking straight ahead no matter what— I 
don't have that kind of strength... Even 
so—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want to believe that I'm strong too..., 
that I have a strength all my own. That's 
why—

My heart warms at Cheval Grand's 
confession. I wonder how many hurdles she 
had to overcome before finally being able 
to put these feelings into words.
choice_data_list: Then there's only one thing to do.
Then there's only one thing to do!

text_block_list.text:
Instead of deciding to run at the last 
minute like this time, next time the goal 
from the start will be to compete against 
Kitasan Black.

I'll challenge Kitasan Black as a true 
rival right from the start, with a burning 
desire to win!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I want to say 'someone like me...' I want 
to run away, saying it's impossible for 
me... but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes... I want to run. —With Kitasan Black.

Cheval Grand, who had previously only ever 
looked at her own weaknesses, is looking 
outward for the very first time.

For the sake of her growth, this will 
surely be a worthwhile race. Or so I 
thought to myself—
